units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>למלך שהיו לו תסבריות … פ׳ אחד של זהב קטן וכ׳</he> like a king who had many (public) treasures and cared not to count them, but he had one small private chest filled with gold &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 1:7:4">Y. Bets. I, 60ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>ומפתחא דפלמנטרין בידיה</he> with the key of his money chest in his hand.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:6:2">Y. Taan. II, 65ᵈ</cite> <he>מפתח של פלמנטרין קטנה</he> (En Yaʿăḳob <cite ref="Q01029"><he>פלטרים</he></cite>, <cite ref="Q01030"><he>פלטרין</he></cite>) a small key of a jewelry box.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 20">Ex. R. s. 20</cite>, beg. <cite ref="D00677"><he>דיפלומטר</he></cite>, <he>הד׳</he>, read: <he>הפלומטר</he>.
